name: giveaway-random-draw
title_zh: 先锁名单后掷骰的抽奖，中签记录人人可验
tagline_zh: 开奖前种子还没诞生，名单和规则已锁死。用 drand 或 NIST 公开随机源定胜负，去重、排除、加权。
tagline_en: Seed comes after rules are locked. Uses drand/NIST beacons, handles dedup, exclusions, weights, tiers.
desc_en: Run or plan a provably fair random draw for a giveaway: commit to the entrant list and rules before the seed exists, take the seed from a public randomness beacon (drand or NIST) or a published value, pick winners from a list, CSV, spreadsheet or comment export with deduplication, exclusions, entry weights, tiers and backups, and produce an audit record anyone can verify. Use when the user asks 'p
why_zh: 不是'我随机选了个数'，而是先提交名单哈希、后取公开信标种子。机制上杜绝了'先看结果再改名单'。
why_en: Not 'I picked a random number'—commit to the list hash first, then pull a public beacon seed. Even the host can't rig it after.
limit_zh: 只负责抽签和审计记录，不代管奖品发放、不处理争议申诉。需要联网获取 drand/NIST 信标。
limit_en: Draws and audit only—no prize fulfillment or dispute resolution. Needs internet for drand/NIST beacons; offline requires your own tamper-proof.
title_en: Commit first, draw later: provably fair giveaway picks
